campaigns.domain_contract: TT01 strict catalog admission: I1 valid base loads with exact-pair lookup; I2 duplicate pair rejects DuplicateId; I3 unknown field rejects UnknownField; I4 truncation rejects; I5 no panic and deterministic verdicts. Time, work and memory bounds are stated separately; memory is observed (peak child RSS, includes cargo wrapper overhead) not enforced.

Bad control: the mutant asserts duplicated (id, version) pairs are accepted. The campaign matches only when the target reports valid setup plus a failed semantic assertion (verdict FAILED). Setup errors and crashes do not satisfy this control.

campaigns.version: scopebase-testkit-fuzz 0.0.0 stable smoke engine driving scopebase-testkit 0.1.0
campaigns.domain_contract: Byte robustness: no input panics and every verdict is deterministic across repeated loads. This finite smoke run covers the seed corpus only (48 inputs); it is not a time-bounded libFuzzer campaign and claims no coverage beyond its scope. The 60-minute qualification campaigns from the TT06 plan remain future work behind the cargo-fuzz admission gate.

campaigns.version: scopebase-catalog-model 0.1.0 under Miri via cargo +nightly miri run (requires a nightly toolchain with the miri component, e.g. rustup toolchain install nightly --component miri)
campaigns.domain_contract: TT06 names Miri for supported pure unsafe boundaries. The bound command is cargo +nightly miri run, requiring a nightly toolchain with the miri component. Tool support is not admitted in this environment, so this campaign records PREREQUISITE_UNMET as an explicit gap rather than substituting another check. PREREQUISITE_UNMET is an incomplete diagnostic: the command gate never passes on it.
